Guideline Name 
Yorvipath (palopegteriparatide)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Yorvipath  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of hypoparathyroidism  


--- PDF page 1974 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1974 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Requested drug is NOT being used in the setting of acute post-surgical 
hypoparathyroidism  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 Patient has achieved albumin-corrected serum calcium of at least 7.8 mg/dL 
(milligrams/deciliter) using calcium and active vitamin D (e.g., calcitriol) treatment  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist  
 
Product Name:Yorvipath  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting that patient demonstrates 
positive clinical response to therapy as evidenced by maintenance of normalized calcium 
levels compared to baseline
